name: Crystal Globe
descriptionTemplate:
The current terrain counts as "Icefield."
In Hyperborea: After the Draw Phase, apply 1 stack of {Stagnation} and {Retain} to the 2 unfrozen Command Cards with the highest Arithmetica Cost in hand. When any Command Card has at least 3 stacks of {Stagnation}, remove its {Stagnation} and {Retain} (obtained from this battle), Freeze it, and apply 25 stacks of {overlay:Enhance}.
lore:
It does not bring the cold.
It merely reminds the earth that winter never left.
